about.title: Swagger Editor App
about.description: Swagger Editor App is a learning project created as part of the RS School React course. It helps users edit, validate, preview and save OpenAPI schemas in a focused workspace with authentication, localization and a responsive split-view interface.
about.courseDescription: RS School is a free, community-driven education program from The Rolling Scopes community. The React course focuses on modern frontend engineering practices: component architecture, routing, state management, testing, authentication, API integration and production-ready user interfaces.

scope.editor: OpenAPI schema editing with JSON and YAML support.
scope.preview: Live Swagger UI preview for quick feedback.
scope.history: Firebase-backed sign in, sign up and schema history.
scope.i18n: Internationalized navigation for English and Russian routes.
